faqs.question: How do I book a deal?
faqs.answer: Open a deal, choose a package and a time, add it to your cart and pay at checkout. You need to sign in before you pay.

faqs.question: How do I sign in?
faqs.answer: Enter your mobile number or email and the one-time password we send you, or continue with Google.

faqs.question: Which payment methods can I use?
faqs.answer: Pay online by card, UPI or netbanking. Razorpay processes every payment, so your card details never reach MySpaDeal servers.

faqs.question: Where can I see my orders?
faqs.answer: Sign in and open My Orders from your account menu. Each order shows its status, the spa branch and your invoice.

faqs.question: Can I cancel or reschedule a booking?
faqs.answer: Each deal lists its own cancellation and rescheduling terms. Check them on the deal page before you pay, and contact the spa or our support team for changes.

faqs.question: How do I get a refund?
faqs.answer: Approved refunds go back to the payment method you used. Banks usually take 5 to 7 working days to show the amount.

faqs.question: Do I need to print my booking?
faqs.answer: No. Show the booking confirmation in My Orders on your phone when you arrive at the spa.

faqs.question: How do I list my spa or products on MySpaDeal?
faqs.answer: Choose Become a member and share your business details. Our partner team reviews your KYC before your deals and products go live.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.description: How MySpaDeal collects, uses, shares and protects your personal information.

body.text: Your name, mobile number and email address, your bookings and orders, and technical data such as device and browser type.

items: To sign you in and run your account
To confirm bookings and process orders

body.text: We share the booking details a partner spa needs to serve you, and payment details with Razorpay to process your payment. We do not sell your information.
We protect your information with access controls and keep it only as long as its purpose or the law requires.
You can update your profile from your account. To ask about or delete your data, contact us.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.description: The terms for using MySpaDeal, booking spa and wellness services and buying products.

body.text: By using MySpaDeal you accept these terms. Give accurate details, keep your sign-in secure and use the platform lawfully.
Bookings depend on the partner spa’s availability. The spa delivers the service; MySpaDeal connects you and processes the payment.
Checkout shows the full price before you pay. Razorpay processes payments by card, UPI or netbanking.
The cancellation and refund terms shown on a deal apply to that booking.
We may update these terms. The date at the top of this page shows the latest version.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.description: How MySpaDeal works to make booking spa and wellness services accessible to everyone.

body.text: We build MySpaDeal to meet the Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.2 at level AA.

items: Every action works with a keyboard
Text and controls meet colour contrast minimums
Pages use real headings, landmarks and labels for screen readers
Layouts adapt to any screen size and to zoom

body.text: If something on MySpaDeal is hard to use, contact us and tell us the page and what happened.

cookies.title: Cookie Policy
cookies.description: How MySpaDeal uses cookies and browser storage, and how you can control them.

body.text: Cookies and browser storage are small pieces of data a website saves on your device.

items: To remember your city and theme
Razorpay sets its own cookies when you pay, to keep the payment secure

body.text: You can clear or block cookies in your browser settings. Blocking them signs you out and resets your city and theme.
